name: Interfaces & Composition — Reusable Reversible Transport (nested chain A↔B↔C)
description: Fig 1 upgraded to the paper's actual composition point. ONE reusable, REVERSIBLE, typed process class (CompartmentTransport) is instantiated on TWO edges of a genuinely NESTED three-compartment place graph: cell ▸ outer (A), cell ▸ inner (B), cell ▸ inner ▸ organelle (C). The topology here is a linear CHAIN A↔B↔C. Each transport conserves source+sink and relaxes to sink/source = k_f/k_r = 4, so the chain reaches the equilibrium distribution A:B:C = 1:4:16 while the total A+B+C is conserved to round-off. The SAME class, rewired into a hub (fig01-mechanistic-star), gives a different equilibrium (1:4:4) with NO change to the process implementation — the dynamics are controlled by the wiring. Runnable (default_n_steps + RAMEmitter).
